definitions.short: Charbona or Charbonah , a eunuch of Xerxes
definitions.full: H2726. Charbona or Charbonah חַרְבוֺנָא proper name, masculine eunuch of Ahasuerus Est 1:10 = חַרְבוֺנָה 7:9 (Persian = donkey driver , Vull i, 668 b ). ךְַרְבּוֺנָה proper name, masculine see foregoing .

occurrences.englishText: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcass, the seven eunuchs who served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,

Then Harbonah, one of the eunuchs who were with the king said, “Behold, the gallows fifty cubits* A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. high, which Haman has made for Mordecai, who spoke good for the king, is standing at Haman’s house.”
